label: Incubate egg
description: When the initial timer is zero, advances32 frames and enters25.

label: Hatch a zombie
description: After36 frames creates a neutral villager with zombie sex and enters26.

label: Wait after hatching
description: Waits until UpdateAI restarts activity0 with probability1/40.

label: Armed spike trap
description: Untriggered trap. Contact selects the active trap mode; spike/flame traps hide this pose from other owners.

label: Trigger spikes
description: Deals area damage every16 frames; after the byte frame counter wraps at256 clears activity.

label: Armed mine
description: The mine loses health as a fuse only in activity 24; zero is its initial untriggered mode.

label: Triggered mine countdown
description: Takes1 damage each Update, eventually triggering normal mine destruction/explosion.

label: Cloud without active rain
description: No rain overlay or extinguishing loop. Cloud appearance/disappearance is controlled separately by state_id.

label: Rain and extinguish fires
description: Every23 frames extinguishes nearby owned burning objects and fires. After20 cycles enters the cloud disappearance state and clears activity.

label: Brewery at rest
description: No brewing animation; depositing grain starts activity 100.

label: Play brewing animation
description: Advances the brewing frame through heading; at frame5 clears activity and resets heading/frame.

label: Tower rock before landing phase
description: The vertical velocity threshold advances activity 0 to 70. Impact then starts 91.

label: Projectile landing phase
description: Landing detection uses nonnegative vertical velocity; impact deals area damage, sets91 and timer72.

label: Wait after impact
description: After impact, decrements the72-tick timer and deletes the projectile when it reaches zero.

label: Fireball before landing phase
description: The vertical velocity threshold advances activity 0 to 70. Impact then starts 91.

label: Projectile landing phase
description: Landing detection uses positive vertical velocity; impact deals area damage, creates an explosion, sets91 and timer72.

label: Wait after impact
description: After impact, decrements the72-tick timer and deletes the projectile when it reaches zero.

label: Stationary grave cross
description: Neither raising (55) nor lowering (56) is active. Completing 55 clears activity and sets timer to 64.

label: Raise grave cross
description: Advances the raising animation, then holds its last frame, clears activity and sets timer64.

label: Lower and remove grave cross
description: Reverses frames; deletes the cross when frame reaches zero.

label: Human death (unit type selects sprite)
description: Draws this death sprite (27 selects it using state_id). SlowTick can change it to skeleton activity37. Only27 has its own frame advance in Update.

label: Murder death sprite
description: Draws murd_wst frame0. Update advances the counter to39, but this drawing branch keeps showing frame0. No natural assignment found.

label: Dead zombie
description: Draws the corresponding creature death sprite. SlowTick can delete the corpse on the random decay check; Update has no dedicated frame advance for this mode.

label: Butchered cow remains
description: Created by completed resident cow butchering. Draws the last cowchopm frame; no dedicated Update or SlowTick activity branch.

label: Exploding cow
description: Advances the corresponding cow death animation; holds its last frame while timer counts down from255, then deletes the corpse.

label: Legacy corpse decay input
description: Accepted by SlowTick as a corpse that can decay into a skeleton; Draw has no dedicated branch for this value.

label: Pikeman death sprite
description: Draws this death sprite (27 selects it using state_id). SlowTick can change it to skeleton activity37. Only27 has its own frame advance in Update.

label: Footman death sprite
description: Draws this death sprite (27 selects it using state_id). SlowTick can change it to skeleton activity37. Only27 has its own frame advance in Update.

label: Flag bearer death sprite
description: Draws this death sprite (27 selects it using state_id). SlowTick can change it to skeleton activity37. Only27 has its own frame advance in Update.

label: Wizard death sprite
description: Draws this death sprite (27 selects it using state_id). SlowTick can change it to skeleton activity37. Only27 has its own frame advance in Update.

label: Skeleton
description: Draws the skeleton sprite. SlowTick can delete the corpse on the random decay check.

label: Dead wolf or dark wolf
description: Draws the corresponding creature death sprite. SlowTick can delete the corpse on the random decay check; Update has no dedicated frame advance for this mode.

label: Dead wasp or blood wasp
description: Draws the corresponding creature death sprite. SlowTick can delete the corpse on the random decay check; Update has no dedicated frame advance for this mode.

label: Dead bat or demon
description: Draws the corresponding creature death sprite. SlowTick can delete the corpse on the random decay check; Update has no dedicated frame advance for this mode.

label: Dead giant
description: Draws the corresponding creature death sprite. SlowTick can delete the corpse on the random decay check; Update has no dedicated frame advance for this mode.

label: Dead ogre
description: Draws the corresponding creature death sprite. SlowTick can delete the corpse on the random decay check; Update has no dedicated frame advance for this mode.

label: Vampire death
description: Advances vampire death frames, then deletes the corpse; SlowTick can also remove it during decay.

label: Cow slaughter animation
description: Advances the corresponding cow death animation; holds its last frame while timer counts down from255, then deletes the corpse.

label: Cow natural death animation
description: Advances the corresponding cow death animation; holds its last frame while timer counts down from255, then deletes the corpse.

label: Firebomb between shots
description: A target after the reload timer expires starts the firing activity 58.

label: Launch fireball
description: Launches the prepared fireball at frame1. At animation end resets timer255, clears activity and destination.

label: Toolshed at rest
description: UpdateAI can start cosmetic activity 88 with probability 1/10.

label: Play toolshed animation
description: Cycles toolshed poses at timer1,9,17,25,33; timer41 clears activity.

label: Loaded bolt trap
description: Untriggered trap. Contact selects the active trap mode; spike/flame traps hide this pose from other owners.

label: Fire bolt
description: Launches the linked bolt by setting its activity23, then immediately enters22.

label: Spent bolt trap
description: Spent state. A worker arriving to reload clears activity and creates a replacement linked bolt.

label: Unlaunched trap bolt
description: The linked bolt is launched by the trap entering activity 21, which assigns bolt activity 23.

label: Bolt in flight
description: Moves down2048 fixed-point units each update; deletes on reaching the ground.

label: Early wheat growth
description: Spring SlowTick advances0 to1; fast-food magic can advance0 directly to ripe stage2.

label: Growing wheat
description: Summer SlowTick advances1 to ripe stage2; winter changes it to withering3.

label: Ripe wheat
description: A young-enough worker can harvest it: wheat enters4 and the worker enters6. Winter instead changes wheat to3.

label: Wither in winter
description: Frame decreases with the withering counter; removes wheat when the frame becomes less than3.

label: Wheat being harvested
description: Reserved by a harvesting resident. If reached_object disappears, clears activity back to0.

label: Harvested wheat pending removal
description: Displays frame0 until SlowTick removes the harvested wheat.

label: Turret between shots
description: After the cooldown, a destination starts activity 59; heading must match the target before firing.

label: Aim and fire tower rock
description: Turns toward the destination, then spawns a tower rock when aligned; clears activity and starts cooldown36.

label: Disguised bush
description: Draws a bush with eyes. UpdateAI can enter looking-around mode44 with probability1/10.

label: Look around before moving
description: UpdateAI attempts a nearby path with probability1/2. With a path enters45; without a path stays44.

label: Emerge from disguise
description: Eight-frame emergence animation, then enters46.

label: Move as bushman
description: Loops the moving bush frames while following the path.

label: Return to disguise
description: Eight-frame concealment animation, then clears activity.

label: Victim animation sprite
description: Draws a victim-specific sprite for sixteen frames, then enters49. The current contact path assigns49 directly, so48 is not established as naturally reachable.

label: Shake after catching a victim
description: Contact deletes the victim and directly selects this mode. After128 frames clears activity.

label: Armed flame trap
description: Untriggered trap. Contact selects the active trap mode; spike/flame traps hide this pose from other owners.

label: Release flames
description: Deals area damage at frame10, then clears activity at the flame-animation end.

label: Walk or idle
description: Normal walking/idle drawing; attack-cycle timer can still advance. Activity zero is also required by normal work selection and mating checks.

label: Butcher a cow
description: At animation wrap clears activity, creates a corpse in activity30, and adds food, water and happiness.

label: Butcher a chicken
description: At animation wrap clears activity and adds food, water and happiness; chicken sound and butcher sound occur at fixed frames.

label: Gather apples
description: At animation wrap clears activity and recreates the picked apple tree object.

label: Harvest wheat
description: Each completed animation reduces anim_timer; after the final cycle clears activity and marks the reached wheat as activity5.

label: Attack
description: Runs the sex-specific attack cycle. Without a target it clears activity and searches for another enemy.

label: Lay stones
description: Repeats work cycles, then marks the stone pile61 and reduces the construction-site work count.

label: Saw wood
description: Repeats work cycles, then marks the wood pile63 and reduces the construction-site work count.

label: Hammer
description: Repeats hammering cycles, then marks the hammer point66 and reduces the construction-site work count.

label: Chop wood
description: Repeats the chopping animation until anim_timer reaches zero, then clears activity.

label: Heal a patient
description: Heals work_object by4 at frame32 while its health is below maximum, looping from frame16. Clears activity at frame44.

label: Play casting animation
description: Runs the casting/healing pose and clears activity after32 frames. The spell itself is handled separately.

label: Zombie spawn marker
description: Assigned to the zombie created by class188 (none_BC), not zombie_tomb191. No dedicated villager Update/Draw activity branch exists for this value.

label: Sleep
description: The shared UpdateAI sleep check clears activity when night ends; the resident uses a sleeping sprite.

label: Milk a cow
description: After12 complete milking cycles clears the resident and reached cow activities.

label: Serve a punishment
description: Runs the sentence stages. SetTarget, SetAction, CommandGoToTile and SetCrime refuse changes while this activity is active.

label: Repair a building
description: Every16 frames adds20 health to work_object. At full health clears burning, ends repair and sends the resident out through the building door.

label: Demolish a building
description: Every16 frames deals30 damage to work_object; ends when the building is gone or marked for deletion.

label: Walk or idle
description: Uses the creature sex-specific walk/idle sprite and attack-cycle timer.

label: Attack
description: Runs the creature sex-specific attack cycle. Once the target is absent and the cycle is sufficiently advanced, clears activity.

label: No contact reaction
description: Resident contact selects reaction 38 or 39. These have no dedicated Update/Draw activity branch for this class.

label: Female contact reaction
description: Interaction assigns this value and plays the resident reaction sound. This is not the creature zombie class; no dedicated Update/Draw activity branch was found for this class.

label: Male contact reaction
description: Interaction assigns this value and plays the resident reaction sound. This is not the creature zombie class; no dedicated Update/Draw activity branch was found for this class.

label: Cow free to wander
description: The cow may choose a random nearby destination. Milking reservation 96, following 90 and milking 94 have separate rules.

label: Timed cow animation
description: Advances anim_timer to52, then clears activity. No natural assignment to53 was found in the scanned code.

label: Advance cow animation frame
description: Increments frame once, then clears activity. No natural assignment to54 was found in the scanned code.

label: Follow owner resident
description: UpdateAI repeatedly follows work_object. If the reference is missing, clears activity. Resident arrival assigns90 when claiming the cow.

label: Cow being milked
description: Maintains the milking link to the resident; clears activity if the reciprocal link is lost. TakeDamage returns early for activity94.

label: Cow reserved for milking
description: PickWork reserves a free cow; if no milking begins, UpdateAI clears the reservation after anim_timer exceeds8.

label: Chicken without collectible egg
description: SlowTick can set activity 92; collecting that egg clears activity and sets timer to 20.

label: Egg ready to collect
description: Draws a collectible egg. Resident arrival consumes it, clears activity and starts timer20.

label: Construction foundation stage
description: Initial foundation stage. Once its initial work count reaches zero, UpdateAI changes the site to67 and creates the upper-stage work points.

label: Construction upper stage
description: Draws the upper construction stage. Once its remaining work count is zero and no unfinished work objects remain, enters68 and replaces the site with its finished building.

label: Construction complete (site replaced)
description: Assigned immediately before deletion and creation of the finished building. Assigning68 alone does not run a separate completion handler.

label: Stone work available
description: Available work point; an arriving worker reserves it and begins the corresponding construction animation.

label: Stone work reserved
description: Worker reservation expires after timer exceeds200, clearing activity; completion instead sets61.

label: Stone work finished
description: Completed work point. The worker reduces the parent site remaining-work count; site completion logic later removes the point.

label: Wood work available
description: Available work point; an arriving worker reserves it and begins the corresponding construction animation.

label: Wood work reserved
description: Worker reservation expires after timer exceeds200, clearing activity; completion instead sets63.

label: Wood work finished
description: Completed work point. The worker reduces the parent site remaining-work count; site completion logic later removes the point.

label: Hammer work available
description: An arriving worker reserves this point with activity 65 and starts hammering activity 11.

label: Hammer work reserved
description: Worker reservation expires after timer exceeds200, clearing activity; completion instead sets66.

label: Hammer work finished
description: Completed work point. The worker reduces the parent site remaining-work count; site completion logic later removes the point.

label: Apply detect traps effect
description: With a caster reference, reveals enemy spike/flame traps and mines within radius8 using trap markers; then deletes the effect.

label: Apply fireball effect
description: With a caster reference, launches a spell_blast projectile from the caster toward this tile; then deletes the effect.

label: Apply cause plague effect
description: Assigns a random disease value0..2 to enemy villagers within radius5; then deletes the effect.

label: Apply protect effect
description: Sets protection flag0x40000000 and effect_timer255 on friendly villagers within radius5; then deletes the effect.

label: Apply summon zombie effect
description: Animates summoning until state58, creates a neutral zombie creature, and deletes the effect.

label: Apply lightning effect
description: Creates a thunder cloud at this tile, then deletes the effect.

label: Apply quench fire effect
description: Creates a rain cloud with activity17, then deletes the effect.

label: Apply cure plague effect
description: Clears disease on objects within radius5, adds cure visuals, then deletes the effect.

label: Apply fast food effect
description: Within radius5 ripens friendly wheat/apple trees and sets friendly cow/chicken timer1; then deletes the effect.

label: Apply fear effect
description: Makes enemy villagers, creatures and cows within radius5 flee; creates flash/fear visuals and deletes the effect.

label: Apply see effect
description: With a caster reference, launches a spell_bolt toward this tile; then deletes the effect. This internal spell name does not imply immediate map reveal.

label: Apply teleport effect
description: With a caster reference, teleports that caster to this tile with flashes at both ends; then deletes the effect.

label: Apply mass heal effect
description: Adds100 health to injured friendly villagers within radius5, adds healing visuals, then deletes the effect.

label: Apply bless effect
description: Within radius1 adds health64, food32, water32, happiness64 and fitness32 to friendly villagers; then deletes the effect.

label: Projectile collision grace period
description: Ignores obstacle-triggered impact until health has fallen by more than16; then enters69.

label: Projectile collision enabled
description: Explodes on obstacle contact or health exhaustion; collision with a resident also reduces remaining health to1.

label: Red healing potion
description: Selecting the red potion adds255 health, plays its sounds and consumes the potion.

label: Green random-effect potion
description: Selecting the green potion chooses one of ten random effects, including harmful effects, spells, healing, intelligence or creature creation.

label: Blue intelligence potion
description: Selecting the blue potion adds255 intelligence, plays its sounds and consumes the potion.

label: Ordinary gate manually open
description: Cursor command clears activity and blockers. Activity 95 selects automatic gate operation; it is not a permanently closed pose.

label: Ordinary gate automatic mode
description: Manual click sets blocking immediately and timer120. Update reduces the timer and eventually clears blocking; a crossing unit changes 95 to97. Thus 95 does not mean a permanent closed state.

label: Ordinary gate passage delay
description: Contact from mode95 plays the opening sound and sets timer24. After expiry and once the tile has no standing unit, Update returns to95 and plays the closing sound.

label: Generator enabled
description: SlowTick generates objects only while activity is zero. Every nonzero value disables generation; no separate named modes are defined.

description: Initial foundation stage. Once its initial work count reaches zero, UpdateAI changes the site to67 and creates the upper-stage work points.

label: Construction complete (site replaced)
description: Assigned immediately before deletion and creation of the finished building. Assigning68 alone does not run a separate completion handler.

label: Closed appearance only
description: Sets the displayed gate pose; this activity alone does not update collision blocking.

label: Open appearance only
description: Sets the displayed gate pose; this activity alone does not update collision blocking.

label: Open
description: Plays the opening animation, then makes the gate tile passable.

label: Close
description: Plays the closing animation and restores collision blocking.

label: Switch lever off
description: Sets the displayed pose and clears/sets the global flag selected by the lever state byte.

label: Switch lever on
description: Sets the displayed pose and clears/sets the global flag selected by the lever state byte.

label: Animate switching lever on
description: Plays the transition, then changes the corresponding global flag on reaching the final pose.

label: Animate switching lever off
description: Plays the transition, then changes the corresponding global flag on reaching the final pose.
